hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *.ts|*.tsx|*.js|*.jsx|*.json|*.css|*.md) cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && pnpm exec oxfmt "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1; case "$f" in *.ts|*.tsx|*.js|*.jsx) pnpm exec oxlint --fix "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 ;; esac ;; esac; exit 0
cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && pnpm typecheck >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'typecheck failed — run pnpm typecheck' >&2; exit 2; }
